benefit_text: When you turn 60 you will get a guaranteed pension of Rs. 1000 per month or Rs. 2000 per month or Rs. 3000 per month or Rs. 4000 per month or Rs. 5000 per month for life. If you die, your spouse gets the same pension. After both die, the nominee receives the saved pension wealth.
who_can_apply: You must be between 18 and 40 years old to join. There is no income limit to join. You must have a savings bank or post office account for auto‑debit of contributions.
documents: Aadhaar card, bank or post office passbook, nominee details form
how_to_apply: Log in to your internet banking or visit the eNPS website, choose Atal Pension Yojana, fill basic and nominee details, give consent for auto‑debit, and complete KYC using Aadhaar OTP, virtual ID or upload Aadhaar XML.
